headline: Requires the planned national monument honoring Medal of Honor recipients to be built within the central area of the National Mall.
what_it_does: This law requires the already-authorized monument honoring Medal of Honor recipients to be placed within the Reserve, the central cross-shaped area of the National Mall that runs from the Capitol to the Lincoln Memorial and from the White House to the Jefferson Memorial.
when_it_takes_effect: Upon enactment on September 10, 2026; the summary gives no other dates.
